node.statement: Using the validated support-vector node 1.1.2.3 in the H0>0 case, the vector s satisfies ||s||_infty <= 1, s dot (x0-y0)=H0, and s dot (y-y0) <= 0 for every y in C. Therefore, for phi(x)=s dot (x-y0), phi(x0)=s dot (x0-y0)=H0, phi(y)=s dot (y-y0) <= 0 on C, and the linear part of phi is s, whose l_infty norm is at most 1.
